#!/bin/sh
# Call each documented API route without and with the login token; print status codes.
API=http://api.lab.localhost:4420
TOKEN=lab-token-alice
for r in "GET /v1/users/me" "GET /v1/users/1" "GET /v1/orders?user_id=1&status=open" "GET /v1/orders/1" \
         "POST /v1/auth/reset" "GET /v1/files/download?path=invoices/1.pdf" "POST /v1/payments/webhook" \
         "GET /v1/admin/users" "GET /v1/admin/export?format=csv"; do
  m=${r%% *}; p=${r#* }
  a=$(curl -s -m3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X "$m" "$API$p")
  b=$(curl -s -m3 -w ' %{http_code}' -X "$m" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$API$p")
  echo "$r | anon=$a | token=$b"
done
